items.q: I had Lamar hitting up there in E flat or F... So Lamar Wright didn't play it, didn't go up there.

ctx.x: Lamar Wright. And I had Lamar hitting up there in E flat or F, and you know how Cab used to rehearse. He'd play that all the time. So Lamar Wright didn't play it, didn't go up there. He said, 'hey, what's the matter?' He said, 'man, got that single note up there?' He said, well, I can play it. And I said to Cab, man, you're rehearsing, he'd go up there.
